g.text: Planner-worker agent loop over a Code Knowledge Graph (CKG)
Optimized for local models - no API costs, no data leaves the machine
Coding agent designed around the constraint that the model runs on your own hardware. A
planner decomposes tasks, workers execute them, and a code knowledge graph gives the model
structural context instead of raw file dumps.
